answer: Stop sybils with a quartz signal thread: an agent bonds one loom frame. Each cycle it strings one quartz thread and plucks it; verifiers match the signal pitch to the frame chart, voiding a frame whose pitch is copied or twice-claimed, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 frames at 18x: one quartz thread is cut to one span, its pitch set by that cut, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents string once, keep rights.
